claims.says: While a thread holds a NoCaptureInFlight, no other thread holds a capture.
Two threads are never both blocked in capture_in_flight or no_capture_in_flight.
One thread can nest exclusions and a capture without waiting on itself, and releasing them all frees the ownership.
A thread blocked in either call waits on the other thread, which holds a capture or the exclusion; by C02 that thread is not blocked, so it can go on and release.
A thread does block while another holds the exclusion, so C02 and C04 constrain states that occur.
An eviction that cannot take the engine permit releases nothing; a request holds that permit from take_session to put_session, so eviction never frees a session a request is using.
An idle eviction releases only held slots whose last put is at least the shorter of 300 s and the global idle limit old.
A pressure eviction releases every held slot.
The idle comparison includes its edge: a slot idle exactly the limit is released, one second less is kept, and a shorter global limit wins.
An idle eviction releases the kept adapter session only when its last put is at least the idle limit old.
A fresh adapter session survives an idle eviction of base slot 0, an idle one is released with it, and pressure eviction releases it when it is the only session held.

findings.title: A thread that takes the exclusion inside its own capture could deadlock the capture machinery
findings.trigger: Old design: a capture counted itself, then queued on capture_lock; an exclusion claimed the excluder, then waited for other threads' captures. A thread inside its capture that took the exclusion waited on a capture queued behind it, or on an excluder waiting for that very capture.
findings.consequence: Both threads hung, and every later capture or exclusion in the process blocked behind them.
findings.repair: capture_in_flight and no_capture_in_flight wait on one condition, that no other thread holds a capture or an exclusion, and only then take theirs; capture_lock is gone. One thread at a time owns the capture machinery, re-entrantly.
findings.test: nv-kernels capture_exclusion tests an_exclusion_inside_a_capture_does_not_wait_on_a_capture_queued_behind_it and an_exclusion_inside_a_capture_does_not_wait_on_an_excluder_waiting_for_that_capture, which timed out on the old code

findings.title: Any eviction dropped the kept adapter session whatever its age, and the cold tier never released it on its own
findings.trigger: NV_Q4EXP_LORA_SESSION_CACHE=1 (set by no deployment), base slot 0 idle for 300 s, the adapter session put 1 s ago.
findings.consequence: The next adapter request prefilled cold; with only the adapter session held, is_loaded() was false, so pressure eviction could not reclaim its device memory.
findings.repair: The kept adapter session is held slot 2 with its own put time; held() reports it, and release_sessions_to_disk takes it only when slot 2 is listed.
